question: In November 2020, which country became the first in the world to make access to menstrual products a right?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Scotland.**__

__
 
• Scotland__ has become the first country to allow free and universal access to menstrual products, including tampons and pads, in public facilities.
 
• Scotland has passed a bill that has made everyone who wants them free of period items such as tampons and pads.
 
• Local authorities are required by the Period Product(Free Provision) (Scotland) Bill passed unanimously, to ensure that period products are usually obtainable free of charge.
